```{=html}
<style>
.w071-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w071-dd .w071-pool {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w071-dd .w071-buckets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w071-dd .w071-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 180px; min-width: 180px; padding: 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w071-dd .w071-bucket.w071-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w071-dd .w071-btitle { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w071-dd .w071-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; }
.w071-dd .w071-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.w071-dd .w071-chip.w071-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w071-dd .w071-chip.w071-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w071-dd .w071-chip.w071-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w071-dd .w071-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w071-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w071-dd .w071-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w071-dd .w071-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w071-dd .w071-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w071-dd .w071-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w071-dd .w071-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w071-dd iw" id="w071-dd">
  <div class="w071-pool" aria-label="cards to sort"></div>
  <div class="w071-buckets">
    <div class="w071-bucket" data-bucket="knows"><div class="w071-btitle">Something one knows</div><div class="w071-slot"></div></div>
    <div class="w071-bucket" data-bucket="has"><div class="w071-btitle">Something one has</div><div class="w071-slot"></div></div>
    <div class="w071-bucket" data-bucket="is"><div class="w071-btitle">Something one is</div><div class="w071-slot"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w071-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w071-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w071-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w071-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w071-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w071-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w071-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    The three factors are categories of evidence for a claim of identity: something one knows (a password or PIN), something one has (a phone, hardware token or key) and something one is (a biometric such as a fingerprint or iris scan). Multi-factor authentication requires evidence from more than one independent category, so a stolen password alone is insufficient &mdash; see <a href="#def-mfa">the definition of multi-factor authentication</a> and <a href="#sec-07-authentication-mfa">the section on authentication and MFA</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w071-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w071-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w071-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w071-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w071-expl');
  const ITEMS = [{"t": "A hardware token", "a": "has"}, {"t": "A password", "a": "knows"}, {"t": "A fingerprint", "a": "is"}, {"t": "A phone", "a": "has"}, {"t": "A PIN", "a": "knows"}, {"t": "An iris scan", "a": "is"}];
  let picked = null;

  function chips() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w071-chip')]; }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w071-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w071-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    chips().forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w071-right', 'w071-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w071-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) {
    bucket.querySelector('.w071-slot').appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  function makeChip(item, i) {
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className = 'w071-chip';
    c.textContent = item.t;
    c.dataset.key = String(i);
    c.dataset.answer = item.a;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement === pool) {
        if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
        unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w071-picked');
        buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w071-armed'));
      } else { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.dataset.key));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(bucket => {
    bucket.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(bucket, picked); unpick(); } });
    bucket.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    bucket.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w071-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(bucket, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w071-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w071-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    chips().forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w071-right', 'w071-wrong');
      const b = c.closest('.w071-bucket');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.bucket === c.dataset.answer) { c.classList.add('w071-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w071-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    const unplaced = ITEMS.length - right - wrong;
    if (right === ITEMS.length) {
      msg.textContent = '\u2713 All correct \u2014 three factors, and a stolen password satisfies only one of them.';
      msg.className = 'w071-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else if (wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going \u2014 ' + unplaced + ' card(s) still to place.';
      msg.className = 'w071-msg iw-msg';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '\u2717 Not yet \u2014 the red cards are in the wrong box. Send them back and try again.';
      msg.className = 'w071-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w071-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    chips().forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.bucket === c.dataset.answer);
      if (bucket) place(bucket, c);
    });
    chips().forEach(c => c.classList.add('w071-right'));
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w071-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w071-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    chips().sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.key) - Number(b.dataset.key))
           .forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it, i)));
})();
</script>
```
